title: Morphing Dropdown
description: A plus button that becomes a multi-select dropdown: the circle stretches upward into the panel, and closing gathers it back into the circle. Gooey SVG liquid, springs and a glyph that spins into a tick.

loop.script: click[4] → click[0] → click[1] → click[4] → wait → click[4] → click[0] → click[1] → click[4]

props.name: items
props.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; shape: "circle" | "cross" | "triangle" | "square" }[]
props.description: The rows. The panel's height follows the count; up to about eight fit.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The ticked rows by id, controlled or uncontrolled. Multi-select: a row keeps the menu open, and a tick persists across open and close.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the ticked ids after a row is toggled.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: Whether the panel is out, controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: theme
props.description: The frame. By default the page's: dark inside a `.dark` ancestor, light elsewhere, followed live.

props.name: sound
props.description: Synthesized liquid sounds on open, close, tick, grab and release (Web Audio, no samples). Off by default; it plays only inside a user gesture.

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the 32px anchor element, so you can position it; the panel opens out of it.

a11y: The trigger is a button with aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls, named by `label`. The panel is a role=menu named by `menuLabel` whose rows are menuitemcheckbox with aria-checked. Enter, Space and ArrowDown on the trigger open it on the first row, ArrowUp on the last; the arrow keys move and wrap, Home and End jump, a letter jumps to the next row that starts with it, Enter and Space toggle a row and keep the menu open, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger, Tab closes and moves on.

The press-and-drag gesture is pointer-only and decorative: the liquid finger never changes state, so keyboard and screen reader use is complete without it. The goo, the seam light and the glyph burst are aria-hidden, and a ticked row is announced by aria-checked, not by its shape.
Reduced motion: no goo choreography, stretch or springs; the panel and the ticks switch state in place.

Contrast on request: under prefers-contrast: more the rim and the selection wash darken; under forced colors the liquid picture steps aside for system-colour borders and a Highlight selection. The default keeps upstream's pale rim and ink.
Right to left: the panel is centered over the trigger, so it does not move; each row's glyph and label follow the page direction.
docs:
Installed `MorphingDropdown` in `components/ui/` with its stylesheet, glyphs, menu wiring, row hover and tick burst next to it, and the shared engine (`liquid-taffy-engine`, in `lib/`) as a dependency; install one engine for all three liquid surfaces.

```tsx
import { MorphingDropdown } from "@/components/ui/morphing-dropdown";

<MorphingDropdown onValueChange={(ids) => console.log(ids)} />
```

The button becomes the dropdown: the circle stretches up into the panel and closing gathers it back. It is a 32px circle: place it with `className` and leave room around it for the panel. Rows are multi-select. It follows the page's theme (a `.dark` ancestor makes it dark) or the `theme` prop; the palette is the `--morphing-dropdown-*` variables. Sound is off unless you pass `sound`.

Press and hold the button or the panel and drag: a liquid finger stretches out of the edge and snaps back on release.

Ported from liquid-taffy by arknow91 (MIT); the license notice is at the end of every file.
